scope: Independent mathematical review of all eleven general M9 completion proofs, targeted integration review, and visual/layout verification of the revised manuscript and guide. Historical proofs were preserved; this is not a new full historical reproof or census enumeration.
checked: All eleven M9 cases are excluded without assuming pivotality, sphericality, unitarity or braiding of the original category.
Self-dual signed lemmas are explicitly scoped; the nonselfdual 529 reduction is handled separately.
Indicator normalization uses the pivotal Fuchs-Runkel-Schweigert theorem (LPRV2025, Theorem 3.9) inside sphericalization. The three involution center checks retain every FS2 sign choice.
Signed dimension-field and different-ideal restrictions derive complete finite coefficient and conductor domains; no arbitrary conductor bound supplies an exclusion.

The 3748 proof constructs a coherent central lift and factors the Drinfeld center, without assuming a braiding or tensor factorization of the input category. Its Galois twist orbit needs six equal-dimension objects against a Gram bound of four.
Both exact completion replay modes passed all 11 cases; seven proof bundles and 61 checker source files are hash-bound. Deliberately corrupted certificates and an actual Farkas ray are rejected.
